# Restoration Royalty

> Restoration Royalty LLC is a 24/7 emergency damage-restoration company serving Miami-Dade and greater Florida from Palmetto Bay, FL. IICRC-certified crews handle water, mold, fire, smoke, and storm damage; every call is answered around the clock on a branded line (786-807-MOLD / 786-807-6653), work is insurance-documented, and inspections are free. It is the flagship brand of the Telvergence network of AI-dispatched local-service brands.

## Main

- [Home](https://restorationroyalties.com/): Services, service areas, 24/7 emergency contact, and free-inspection details

## Services

- Water damage restoration
- Mold remediation
- Fire and smoke damage restoration
- Roof tarping and hurricane/storm damage repair

## Service area

- Miami-Dade: Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Homestead, Palmetto Bay
- Greater Florida: Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Port Charlotte, Punta Gorda, Orlando, Venice, Pensacola, Tallahassee
